intro: Set the level of each camp and what it trains or promotes. All three camps share one training capacity: the capacity of the three camp levels added together, plus the bonuses below.

bonuses.title: Capacity and speed
bonuses.researchCapacityHint: Training capacity from research, as the game shows it.
bonuses.trainingSpeedHint: Your speed as the game shows it, without the buffs below.

results.title: Results
results.noRuns: Set at least one camp to train or promote to see the troops, power, resources and time.
results.noChange: These runs change no troops. Set a count above 0.

tiers.promotionNote: A promotion takes troops and their power from the lower tier and adds them to the higher tier, so the lower tier shows a negative change.
tiers.fireCrystalNote: Power uses the Fire Crystal level of each camp: {levels}. Only tiers 10 and 11 change with the level. Stat bonuses from research or gear are not included.

time.title: Time
time.longest: Longest camp (the camps train at the same time)
time.note: The time of a batch is the time of one troop times the troops, divided by 1 plus the training speed, before speedups.

events.title: Event points
events.note: Training points count the troops of training runs at their tier. A promotion gives no training points. Speedup points use the {minutes} speedup minutes needed for all camps. Hall of Chief points are for one season, and its points for raising power are not included.
